brief.t: START HERE: Call Sam and Ron to confirm Talova’s safety approver and authorized recovery method.

ACT NOW 1: Talova safe recovery remains unverified. November 3 splash report is 9 days old. No later safe-method approval, accepted trial evidence or suspect-unit disposition found in bounded sources; lack of clearance is not proof no work occurred. Send internally: Sam, Ron and Aaron, please name the approver and record the safe recovery method, trial results and suspect-unit disposition today before affected-method reuse or a completion promise.

ACT NOW 2: Use today’s 9 AM Ecolab call to resolve Roon readiness dates. Projected November 18 start is 6 days away. Ecolab’s sample delivery is only conditionally targeted by November 20; recommendations are not approved sanitation. Estogel stock is pending and payment application needs reconciliation. New material orders do not clear nine-shortage, capper-trial or usable-lot gates. Send internally: Michael and Aaron, join the 9 AM Ecolab call with the equipment-cleaning requirements and record the sanitation, released-material and capper-trial gates today before we reaffirm November 18.

ACT NOW 3: Heritage shipment request needs a verified owner and callback. Joseph’s November 10 request is 2 days old; he followed up urgently yesterday after failed phone/contact attempts. He says a PO is waiting on the dock. Physical stock, exact PO, QC release and shipping authority are not verified; a callback is not a dispatch promise. Send internally: Sam and Steve, please identify Joseph’s Heritage PO, verify stock, QC and shipping readiness, and give him a callback today before promising dispatch.
